summary: Verified AI Document Reader end-to-end after refactor. All 8 backend pytest cases passed and full frontend flow confirmed: login -> /document-reader -> file upload (no mandatory client dropdown) -> prompt selection UI with 6 presets + custom textarea -> Full Analysis click -> formatted Summary tab (human-readable, NOT raw JSON) -> Raw Data tab shows JSON -> Recent Analyses list appears.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentReader.jsx line 21-23 auto-detects API URL via window.location.origin when not on localhost. This works for the preview URL but is a subtle deviation from the standard REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL-only pattern; acceptable here but note for consistency.

Frontend still imports Select/SelectContent/SelectItem etc. (line 7) and clients state (line 343) / handleSaveToClient (line 442) are dead code now that client linkage was removed from the upload flow. Minor cleanup opportunity; does not affect functionality.

AnalysisResult is used with onSaveToClient/clients props (line 630-633) but the component signature (line 44) only accepts {analysis, onDelete}. These extra props are ignored without error but indicate leftover code from the previous flow.
seed_data_creation: Used a small generated blank PNG (400x300 white) for both backend and frontend analyze calls. Real GPT-4o returned raw_analysis string ('no visible content') which the Summary tab rendered as formatted human-readable text inside the 'AI Analysis Summary' card — NOT as raw JSON. The 3 created test analyses were cleaned up via the DELETE endpoint tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend POST /api/documents/analyze accepts Optional client_id and Optional custom_prompt via multipart form. PDF->image conversion handles up to 5 pages. Frontend DocumentReader.jsx flow: drop file -> showPromptInput=true -> 6 preset buttons OR free-text textarea -> handleAnalyze(prompt) -> AnalysisResult card with 3 tabs (Summary/Details/Raw Data). Summary tab renders rawAnalysis string or data.summary_text or key_insights array as formatted text (NOT JSON.stringify). Only Raw Data tab shows JSON dump. test_document_reader.py has 8 pytest cases covering no-client, custom-prompt, list/get/delete, invalid file, and unauth. All pass in ~5s because GPT-4o responds quickly on tiny blank images.
